```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)

# reading in data
predation <- read_xlsx("projects/2024-fall-coexistence/Predator Frequency.xlsx")
sightings <- read_xlsx("projects/2024-fall-coexistence/sightings.xlsx")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#storing colors
darkbrown <- "#713A1C"
dark_olive1 <- "#3A520C"
khakisp <- "#BDB76B"

```

```{r}
#| echo: false

#cleaning data
predation_clean <- predation |> 
  # cleaning names
  clean_names() |> 
  # keeping relevant rows
  select(predator, farmers_who_reported_attacks) |>
  # dropping null values
  drop_na() |> 
  #reordering species names
  mutate(predator = as_factor(predator),
         predator = fct_relevel(predator,
                                    "Domestic Dog",
                                    "Peuco",
                                    "Vison",
                                    "Güiña",
                                    "Fox",
                                    "Puma")) 

```

```{r}
#| echo: false

#cleaning data
sightings_clean <- sightings |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  select(predators, farmers_who_reported_sightings) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  mutate(predators = as_factor(predators),
         predators = fct_relevel(predators,
                                    "Domestic Dog",
                                    "Peuco",
                                    "Vison",
                                    "Güiña",
                                    "Fox",
                                    "Traro",
                                    "Puma")) 

```


```{r}
#making bar graph for predation graph

#base layer: ggplot
ggplot(data = predation_clean,
       mapping = aes(x = predator,
                     y = farmers_who_reported_attacks)) +
  #adding geometry: bar graph
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Predator",
       y = "Farmers Who Reported Predation",
       title = "Predation events in Small-scale Farms in the Araucania Region of Chile")
```

```{r}
# making bar graph for sightings graph

#base layer: ggplot
ggplot(data = sightings_clean,
       mapping = aes(x = predators,
                     y = farmers_who_reported_sightings)) +
  #adding geometry: bar graph
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Predator",
       y = "Farmers Who Reported Predators on Property",
       title = "Predator Sightings in Small-scale Farms in the Araucania Region of Chile")
```
